consistent_source_observations.detail: Target REG_WRITE is volatile uint32 full-word assignment at0x600080e8; helper is called by app_main, followed by memw and volatile read. Arithmetic changes only mask0x08000000 relative captured before. It still re-emits all captured RW/reserved/RO/WO positions and is not atomic or physically neutral.

ROdetector31, WOcounterclear29, RWselector27, reserved3:0; no W1C field in this BOD word. ObservedWO1 refuses helper, WO0 is not state/safety proof. Separate RTCinterruptclear register and SDK ISR effects do not establish reset polarity.

Raw RESET_STATE CPU causes RO5:0/11:6, no clearing/normalizing. ExistingTRM506: GPIO46strapbit2,GPIO0bit3; liveGPIO46 fromIN1bit14 is separate. eFuseprintRO7:6 guard rejects01/10, permits00/11, no fuse write or newGPIO8/GPIO46 authority.

Known CONFIG_ESP_BROWNOUT_DET=n suppresses esp_brownout_init call, not ROM/hardware. S3 USE_INTR defaults n; brownout.c can still be compiled dueSOC_BOD_SUPPORTED. Optional ISR clear/callback/stopothercore/hint/software_reset is not a polarity witness. NonISR HAL config touches enables/reset/threshold/otherfields; CHIP0/SYSTEM1 enum values do not resolve conflicting TRM.
